s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute progressive parkinsonian syndrome with bilateral upper limb rigidity and gait disturbance
key_facts: History of hypertension and breast cancer
Episode of vomiting and diarrhea 1 month prior to presentation
Gradual development of difficulty in moving extremities
Difficulty in getting up or walking steadily
Normal vitamin B1, thyroid function, and lactate levels
Normal blood gas analysis without acidosis
Brain MRI showed high-intensity areas in bilateral lenticular nucleus with lentiform fork sign

Atypical Parkinsonian Syndrome due to Gaucher's Disease
Parkinsonism due to Neurodegeneration with Brain Iron Accumulation

shortlist.label: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute progressive parkinsonian syndrome with bilateral upper limb rigidity and gait disturbance, consistent with clinical presentation

shortlist.label: Multiple System Atrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Parkinsonian features, autonomic dysfunction, and cerebellar ataxia, which may be present in this case

shortlist.label: Corticobasal Degeneration
shortlist.why_kept: Asymmetric parkinsonism, rigidity, and bradykinesia, with possible alien limb syndrome, consistent with some clinical features

shortlist.label: Parkinson's Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Classic parkinsonian symptoms such as bradykinesia, rigidity, and gait disturbance, although the subacute progression is atypical

shortlist.label: Vascular Parkinsonism
shortlist.why_kept: History of hypertension and diabetes, which are risk factors for vascular disease, and possible vascular parkinsonism given the subacute progression

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of bradykinesia, rigidity, hypophonia, and gait disturbance with short and shuffling steps are classic for Parkinson's Disease. The brain MRI showing high-intensity areas in bilateral lenticular nucleus with lentiform fork sign and the absence of decreased accumulation on dopamine transporter scan also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Multiple System Atrophy
rejected.why: No significant autonomic dysfunction or cerebellar ataxia

rejected.label: Corticobasal Degeneration
rejected.why: No significant asymmetric motor symptoms or alien limb phenomenon

rejected.label: Vascular Parkinsonism
rejected.why: No evidence of vascular lesions on brain MRI
